description: This file defines the TenantObject class in the org.eclipse.hono.util package, representing tenant information used in the Eclipse Hono IoT platform. It provides methods for managing tenant properties, trust anchors, adapter configurations, resource limits, and tracing settings.

classes.name: TenantObject
classes.description: A final class encapsulating tenant information, extending JsonBackedValueObject, providing property accessors, configuration management, trust anchor handling, and utility factory methods.

methods.name: setProperty
methods.description: Adds a property to the tenant with a given name and value, supporting command chaining.

methods.name: getTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves the tenant's identifier.

methods.name: setTenantId
methods.description: Sets the tenant's identifier.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if the tenant is enabled.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables the tenant.

methods.name: setTrustAnchor
methods.description: Sets a trusted CA, given its public key and subject DN, for the tenant.

methods.name: getTrustAnchor
methods.description: Returns the first trust anchor if set; deprecated.

methods.name: getTrustAnchors
methods.description: Returns the set of trust anchors for this tenant, constructing them from JSON data if necessary.

methods.name: getTrustAnchorForPublicKey
methods.description: Constructs a TrustAnchor object for a given JSON object containing key info.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurationsAsMaps
methods.description: Returns adapter configurations as an unmodifiable list of maps.

methods.name: getAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Returns adapter configurations as a JsonArray.

methods.name: getAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves configuration for a specific adapter type.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets adapter configurations from a list of maps.

methods.name: setAdapterConfigurations
methods.description: Sets adapter configurations from a JsonArray.

methods.name: addAdapterConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a single adapter configuration given as a JsonObject.

methods.name: isAdapterEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a specific adapter is enabled for the tenant.

methods.name: getMaxTimeUntilDisconnect
methods.description: Retrieves the max time until disconnect for an adapter type.

methods.name: from (tenantId, enabled)
methods.description: Creates a new TenantObject with tenantId and enabled status.

methods.name: from (enabled)
methods.description: Creates a new TenantObject with enabled status only.

methods.name: newAdapterConfig
methods.description: Creates a JsonObject configuring an adapter type with enabled status.

methods.name: getResourceLimits
methods.description: Retrieves the resource limits for the tenant.

methods.name: setResourceLimits (JsonObject)
methods.description: Sets resource limits from a JsonObject.

methods.name: setResourceLimits (ResourceLimits)
methods.description: Sets resource limits.

methods.name: getMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Gets the minimum message size in bytes.

methods.name: setMinimumMessageSize
methods.description: Sets the minimum message size, throws if negative.

methods.name: getDefaults
methods.description: Gets default properties for all devices of the tenant.

methods.name: setDefaults
methods.description: Sets default properties for all devices of the tenant.

methods.name: getTracingConfig
methods.description: Returns the tenant's tracing configuration.

methods.name: setTracingConfig
methods.description: Sets the tenant's tracing configuration.
